top_signals.title: Chipmakers Under Pressure; Saudi Arabia Intercepts Missiles
top_signals.summary: A selloff in chipmakers drag US equity futures down ahead of bank earnings. Saudi Arabia intercepted more ballistic missiles launched by Yemen's Houthis, targeting Riyadh and Khamis Mushait. Nandan Nilekani of Infosys speaks exclusively with Bloomberg's Shery Ahn at the Bloomberg New Economy Forum in New Delhi. Seema Shah of Principal Asset Management joins "Bloomberg Brief" to look ahead to bank earnings. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: South African clothing retailer Foschini Group investigating cyberattack on British fashion brands
top_signals.summary: The South African retail giant The Foschini Group (TFG) disclosed a cyberattack that disrupted IT systems at three of its British fashion brands, leaving some services unavailable.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
